mechanism_narrative: The Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) level is inversely related to S&P 500 20-day forward returns: lower rates predict positive returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 5.5% signals a weakening labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE is above 5.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST falls below 1000 and INDPRO falls below 103, it signals a weakening economy that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1000 AND INDPRO < 103 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime defined by FEDFUNDS above 2.0% and CPIAUCSL above 235, S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in the regime defined by FEDFUNDS > 2.0% AND CPIAUCSL > 235 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO is above 100 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST falls below 1000, it signals a slowdown in the housing market that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST is below 1000 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS falls below 138000 and UNRATE rises above 5.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS < 138000 AND UNRATE > 5.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market regime defined by HOUST below 1000 and RSAFS below 400000, S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1000 AND RSAFS < 400000 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
